title: New Shopping Carts Start With Someone Else's Items
description:
`ShoppingCart` should start empty every time you create a new one, unless you explicitly pass in starting items. Right now, creating a second `ShoppingCart` with no arguments shows items left over from a completely different cart. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Class**
`ShoppingCart(items=None)` with `.add(item)` and `.items`

**Example**
Create a `ShoppingCart`, add `"apple"`. Create a second, unrelated `ShoppingCart()` with no arguments — its `.items` should be `[]`, not `["apple"]`.
